verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a "Link external directory" option for picking a folder or Document Package through the Files app, which brings content from other apps' storage under git control (docs-26). It also documents dragging files in from other apps (docs-25) and exposing its own repositories to third-party apps via the document picker (docs-24). WebDAV and Shortcuts offer further documented paths for moving files between apps (docs-27, docs-28). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of linked external directories, and documentation of how linked directories persist or what limits apply when working inside other apps' sandboxes.
